section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the psychometric properties of a Polish translation of the BAS-2 scale. The study found a one-dimensional factor structure consistent with the original English version, full scalar invariance across sex (with no significant differences between men and women in total scores), and adequate internal consistency. The research confirmed convergent validity, showing that higher body appreciation was associated with positive emotions and well-being, while lower body appreciation was linked to shame and guilt; notably, negative correlations between body appreciation and BMI were also found.
